ModelsSettings.description: The model configuration of `--model-config` and of the `models` kind of `/$/server/settings/models`: providers, role lists and routing. The web UI builds its form from this schema.

providers.description: The providers by name. A name has letters, digits, _, - and . only.
providers.title: Providers

roles.description: The provider and model pairs each step calls, in order. A role list is one field.

community.description: The reports of GraphRAG communities. It uses the summarize list when unset, and an empty list turns it off.
community.title: community

draft.description: The first draft of a query from a question. The first entry answers, and the server moves to the next only on the signals it verifies. The role is off when unset.
draft.title: draft

explain.description: The prose of a query explanation. The role is off when unset.
explain.title: explain

extract.description: Extraction from document chunks and the CSV mapping draft. The role is off when unset.
extract.title: extract

optimize.description: A proposed query rewrite. The role is off when unset.
optimize.title: optimize

repair.description: A new draft after a diagnosis. It uses the draft list when unset, and an empty list turns it off.
repair.title: repair

summarize.description: The answer from the rows. The role is off when unset.
summarize.title: summarize

roles.title: Roles

routing.description: When a question starts at the second entry of a role list.

complexityThreshold.description: A query whose complexity score reaches it starts repair, or the next draft, at the second entry of its list. A dataset's assistant settings can override it.
complexityThreshold.title: Complexity threshold

exampleScore.description: The score from 0 to 1 that the best stored example needs before its complexity counts.
exampleScore.title: Example score

routing.title: Routing
